content: अनाथ {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] Helpless, poor, forlorn, parentless, orphan (as a child); widowed (as a wife); having no master or natural protector, without a protector in general; नाथवन्तस्त्वया लोकास्त्वमनाथा विपत्स्यसे <ls>U. 1. 43</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 12</ls>. .{@-थम्@} <ab>Ved.</ab> Helplessness. किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति . <ls>Rv. 10. 10. 11</ls>.
